coleccionista.hola: The Collector's Games is running with %s
coleccionista.chat.eliminado: has been eliminated and is now part of the collection.
coleccionista.chat.ganador: %s is the last piece. My collection is complete... for now.
coleccionista.chat.equipos: The teams are set. You didn't choose your teammates... and they didn't choose you.
coleccionista.chat.parejas: The pairs are set. Trust yours... if you can.
coleccionista.fantasma.eres: You are a ghost now: you see everything, but the living can't see or hear you.
coleccionista.fantasma.no_hablar: Ghosts can't talk to the living.
coleccionista.escena.mi_titulo: YOU HAVE BEEN ADDED TO THE COLLECTION
coleccionista.escena.mi_sub: You are a ghost now. Watch, but you can't help anyone.
coleccionista.cmd.quitado: %s is no longer in the event.
coleccionista.cmd.organizador: Done: they are organizers (they don't play).
coleccionista.cmd.reiniciar_confirmar: This erases the whole event. If you're sure: /evento reiniciar confirmar
coleccionista.cmd.reiniciado: The event was erased: everyone is back to normal.
coleccionista.panel.inscribir_todos_ayud: Adds everyone online who isn't an organizer.
coleccionista.panel.yo_organizador_ayuda: Removes you from the pieces and makes you an organizer (you don't play).
coleccionista.panel.eliminar_ayuda: Sends them to the collection: chat announcement, scene, and they become a ghost.
coleccionista.panel.revivir_ayuda: In case of a mistake: back in the game where they are.
coleccionista.panel.seguir_ayuda: The camera follows this piece. Move to release it.
coleccionista.panel.quitar_ayuda: Removes them completely (doesn't count as eliminated).
coleccionista.panel.elige: Pick a piece from the list.
coleccionista.panel.vacio: Nobody yet. Use "Sign up everyone" or /evento bots 8 to test.
coleccionista.panel.anunciar_ayuda: Type something and it shows in chat as if the Collector said it.
coleccionista.panel.reiniciar_ayuda: Erases the whole event. Press it twice.
coleccionista.panel.guardar_toma_ayuda: Saves where you are and where you look as a camera shot.
coleccionista.panel.viajar_ayuda: The camera glides to the chosen shot.
coleccionista.panel.recorrido_ayuda: Glides through every shot in order (great to present a trial).
coleccionista.panel.espectador_ayuda: So the camera can fly and go through walls.
coleccionista.panel.camara_nota: Move (W A S D) to release the camera. F1 hides everything from Minecraft. K key: event HUD.
coleccionista.panel.sin_tomas: No shots. Go where you want to record and press "Save here".
coleccionista.panel.tomas_llenas: There are already %s shots: delete one.
coleccionista.voz.bienvenida.que_tenemos: Well, well… What do we have here?
coleccionista.voz.bienvenida.durmieron: I see you're awake. Did you sleep well?
coleccionista.voz.bienvenida.acerquense: Don't be shy. Come closer… (press R to see the screen up close)
coleccionista.voz.bienvenida.presento: Allow me to introduce myself. I am… the Collector.
coleccionista.voz.bienvenida.coleccion: And you are… my new collection.
coleccionista.voz.bienvenida.pruebas: Tonight you will face several trials, one after another.
coleccionista.voz.bienvenida.solo_uno: And in the end… only one will be able to leave.
coleccionista.voz.bienvenida.los_demas: The rest… stay with me forever.
coleccionista.voz.bienvenida.risa: Heh, heh, heh… Ha, ha, ha!
coleccionista.voz.salida.todas: All of you out of your cells. Nobody stayed behind… what a pity.
coleccionista.voz.salida.museo: What you see is the entrance to my museum. Walk carefully: the floor is old… like me.
coleccionista.voz.salida.salas: Behind every door there is a hall. And in every hall, a trial.
coleccionista.voz.salida.porton: Follow the red carpet. On the other side of the gate… I'll be waiting.
coleccionista.voz.equipos.formen: Now form teams. Of two… or of three.
coleccionista.voz.equipos.ascensor: Each team, into a lift. Not one more… not one less.
coleccionista.voz.equipos.solos: Those left alone… stay with me.
coleccionista.voz.sentidos.mesa: On the table there are three gifts: a blindfold, a tape… and handcuffs.
coleccionista.voz.sentidos.venda: Whoever takes the blindfold will see nothing.
coleccionista.voz.sentidos.cinta: Whoever takes the tape will not be able to speak.
coleccionista.voz.sentidos.esposas: And whoever takes the handcuffs… will not be able to touch anything.
coleccionista.voz.sentidos.parejas: If you are two, there is no tape: one can't see… and the other can't touch.
coleccionista.voz.sentidos.cadena: And you will be chained. Together until the exit.
coleccionista.voz.sentidos.ultimo: The last team out… stays in my display case.
coleccionista.voz.vitrina.quietos: Don't move. The straps are old… but they hold.
coleccionista.voz.vitrina.piezas: I always wanted pieces like this: with fear on their faces.
coleccionista.voz.vitrina.cera: The wax is hot. It will hurt… a little.
coleccionista.voz.vitrina.risa: Heh, heh, heh… Ha, ha, ha!
coleccionista.voz.vitrina_fin.siguen: The rest of you… follow me. The show goes on.
coleccionista.voz.antesala.servian: Those were no use to me. You… still are.
coleccionista.voz.antesala.casa: Follow the hallway. My house awaits.
coleccionista.voz.montacargas.viaje: Breathe deep… it's just a little gas.
coleccionista.voz.montacargas.cloacas: Next stop: the sewers. Down there, nothing ever dries.
coleccionista.voz.montacargas.archivo: Next stop: my archive. That's where I keep the secrets of all my pieces.
coleccionista.voz.montacargas.salon: Next stop: the game parlor. Start thinking about who you trust.
coleccionista.voz.montacargas.laberintos: Next stop: the mazes. You may start closing your eyes.
coleccionista.voz.montacargas.capilla: Next stop: the chapel. A fine place to pray… or to offer yourself.
coleccionista.voz.montacargas.puertas: Next stop: the hall of doors. Three ways… and one has no floor.
coleccionista.voz.montacargas.final: Last stop: my private chamber. Very few pieces make it this far.
coleccionista.voz.montacargas.galeria: Special stop: the gallery of posts. Walk in line… and don't get tangled.
coleccionista.voz.encadenados.hola: Good evening, pieces. Welcome to the sewers.
coleccionista.voz.encadenados.cadena: Each of you is chained to the wall… and to another piece.
coleccionista.voz.encadenados.pareja: Your partner for tonight. You didn't choose her. I did.
coleccionista.voz.encadenados.llaves: You don't have your key. It's in your partner's barrel.
coleccionista.voz.encadenados.lanzar: Ask for it politely. And when you have it… throw it with good aim.
coleccionista.voz.encadenados.gas: When the gate opens, the gas will start coming down the tunnels. I wouldn't breathe it for long.
coleccionista.voz.encadenados.refugio: At the end there is a shelter. It's small. Not all of you fit.
coleccionista.voz.encadenados.vitrina: What binds you… can also save you. The display case is open.
coleccionista.voz.traidor.hola: Welcome to my archive. Here I keep everything I know about you… which is a lot.
coleccionista.voz.traidor.boveda: Each room has a vault locked with a code.
coleccionista.voz.traidor.notas: Each of you has a note with two numbers. Together, you have the whole code.
coleccionista.voz.traidor.traidor: But in every room there is a traitor. A cheap replica among original pieces.
coleccionista.voz.traidor.miente: Their note lies… and the traitor knows it.
coleccionista.voz.traidor.intentos: You have three tries. If you open the vault, the traitor is mine.
coleccionista.voz.traidor.si_no: If you don't… the traitor chooses who I take.
coleccionista.voz.traidor.vitrina: Tell me… who do you trust? The display case is open.
coleccionista.voz.compartir.hola: Welcome to my game parlor. Take a seat… face to face.
coleccionista.voz.compartir.mesa: The piece in front of you is your partner at this table.
coleccionista.voz.compartir.hablen: You have one minute to talk. Promise whatever you like: promises cost nothing.
coleccionista.voz.compartir.elijan: Then each of you will choose in secret: share… or steal.
coleccionista.voz.compartir.comparten: If you both share, you both go on.
coleccionista.voz.compartir.roba: If one steals, only the thief goes on.
coleccionista.voz.compartir.roban: And if you both steal… you both stay with me.
coleccionista.voz.compartir.vitrina: Trust is a very fine piece: it breaks at nothing. The display case is open.
coleccionista.voz.ciegas.hola: Welcome to my mazes. Padded walls… so nobody gets chipped.
coleccionista.voz.ciegas.venda: Almost all of you will walk blindfolded. You'll only see a flash… every now and then.
coleccionista.voz.ciegas.guia: In each team, one piece will be the guide. She'll walk above, on the glass, and see everything.
coleccionista.voz.ciegas.voz: But she can't come down. All she has is her voice.
coleccionista.voz.ciegas.trampas: There are traps on the floor. Whoever steps on one goes back to the entrance.
coleccionista.voz.ciegas.mueven: And since I get bored easily… every now and then I move them.
coleccionista.voz.ciegas.baldosas: There are also tiles on the path that light up. Cross them when they're dark.
coleccionista.voz.ciegas.ultimo: The last team out loses its guide. For guiding badly.
coleccionista.voz.ciegas.vitrina: Listen carefully. The display case is open.
coleccionista.voz.sacrificio.hola: Welcome to my chapel. Here you come to ask… and to give.
coleccionista.voz.sacrificio.reja: Each room has a gate. It only opens if someone stays inside.
coleccionista.voz.sacrificio.altar: Whoever stands on the altar for five seconds offers herself. The others walk free.
coleccionista.voz.sacrificio.votar: If nobody offers, you'll vote in secret. The piece with the most votes stays.
coleccionista.voz.sacrificio.vitrina: Brave pieces are the most beautiful in my collection. The display case is open.
coleccionista.voz.puertas.hola: Welcome to the hall of doors.
coleccionista.voz.puertas.tres: Three doors. Behind each one, a booth.
coleccionista.voz.puertas.piso: In one of them the floor opens… and the water below is very, very deep.
coleccionista.voz.puertas.pista: Before each round I'll give you a clue. I almost always tell the truth. Almost.
coleccionista.voz.puertas.juntas: If you all choose the same door, that time the floor holds. Agree with each other… if you can.
coleccionista.voz.puertas.tiempo: Choose quickly: whoever isn't in before the gates come down lets me choose for her.
coleccionista.voz.puertas.vitrina: May luck be with you. The display case is open.
coleccionista.voz.copas.hola: Welcome to my private chamber. Very few pieces make it this far.
coleccionista.voz.copas.llegaron: You are the finest of my collection. The strongest. The most beautiful.
coleccionista.voz.copas.copas: There are glasses on the table. They all smell the same. They all shine the same.
coleccionista.voz.copas.turnos: Taking turns, each of you will drink a glass. The last piece standing… walks free.
coleccionista.voz.copas.promesa: And I always keep my promises.
coleccionista.voz.tres.hola: Welcome to my gallery of posts.
coleccionista.voz.tres.objetos: On your table there are three gifts: a blindfold, a tape and handcuffs.
coleccionista.voz.tres.venda: Whoever wears the blindfold won't see a thing. Only a flash, now and then.
coleccionista.voz.tres.cinta: Whoever wears the tape won't say a single word.
coleccionista.voz.tres.esposas: And whoever wears the handcuffs… won't touch a thing.
coleccionista.voz.tres.decidan: Decide among yourselves who wears what. If you don't, I will.
coleccionista.voz.tres.cadena: Then you'll cross the gallery chained in a line. Mind the posts: chains get tangled.
coleccionista.voz.tres.vitrina: The last trio out stays with me. The display case is open.
coleccionista.chat.candados: The locks work now. Find the three numbers… or stay here forever.
coleccionista.diario.1: Day 3. I can't hear the piece next door anymore. Yesterday they screamed. Today there's only silence… and a new portrait in the hall.
coleccionista.diario.2: Don't trust your partner. I did. Now I'm writing this from… I don't know where.
coleccionista.diario.3: The Collector never lies. That's the worst part.
coleccionista.diario.4: If you find this: the numbers are never where you look first. Search where you sleep, where you wash… and where nobody looks.
coleccionista.diario.5: I counted the cells: twenty-four. I counted the beds: twenty-four. I counted the exits: one.
coleccionista.diario.6: His laugh gets stuck in your head. He laughs when someone fails.
coleccionista.diario.7: Don't sleep. When you sleep, he moves things around.
coleccionista.diario.8: The mask is cracked on one side. Up close, I'd swear something moves behind the crack.
coleccionista.candado.ayuda: Drag a wheel up or down  ·  Red button: try  ·  Esc: leave
coleccionista.candado.muerto: The lock has no light… yet.
coleccionista.espera.nota: Don't disconnect: when everyone is ready, it will begin.
coleccionista.cmd.sin_mapa: Build the map first: /evento construir (stand where the west corner goes).
coleccionista.cmd.sala: Waiting room ready: everyone in their cell, in bed, in the dark.
coleccionista.cmd.solo_overworld: The map goes in the overworld.
coleccionista.panel.g_sala_ayuda: Everyone to their cell, in bed, in the dark, unable to touch anything.
coleccionista.panel.g_despertar_ayuda: Lights on and everyone wakes up with their cinematic. Then they wait 10 minutes with no clues; at the end there is a blackout and the hidden numbers appear in each cell.
coleccionista.panel.g_discurso_ayuda: End the wait now: blackout, the hidden numbers appear in the cells and the Collector speaks.
coleccionista.panel.g_abrir_ayuda: Opens every door even without the code.
coleccionista.panel.g_disfraz_ayuda: Put on (or take off) the Collector's costume to appear in front of everyone.
coleccionista.enc.sin_mapa: The Sewers aren't built yet: use /evento construir.
coleccionista.enc.ya_empezo: Chained is already running: end it before preparing it again.
coleccionista.enc.pocos: At least 2 living pieces are needed.
coleccionista.enc.fundido: You wake up with something cold and heavy around your ankle…
coleccionista.enc.lema: What binds you… also saves you
coleccionista.enc.chat.empieza: The gate is open. The Shelter only has room for %s of %s pairs. The gas comes out in %s seconds.
coleccionista.enc.llave_vieja: This key doesn't open anything anymore.
coleccionista.enc.ya_libre: You're no longer chained to the wall.
coleccionista.enc.llave_ajena: This key belongs to Piece %s: throw it to them with Q.
coleccionista.enc.libre: The shackle opened! Now get out together.
coleccionista.enc.chat.cierre: There's no more room in the Shelter. The gate closes… and the gas waits for no one.
coleccionista.enc.chat.tiempo: Time's up. The gate closes… and the gas waits for no one.
coleccionista.enc.chat.fin: The trial is over. %s pairs were saved. The rest… are mine now.
coleccionista.enc.cmd.preparada: Chained is ready: everyone to the Shackle Hall (Shelter spots: %s).
coleccionista.enc.cmd.sin_marca: Marker %s doesn't exist (or the Sewers aren't built).
coleccionista.enc.cmd.gracia: The gas will come out %s seconds after the gate opens.
coleccionista.enc.cmd.terminada: Chained ended: no chains, gates open and keys removed.
coleccionista.item.llave_ayuda: Opens a single shackle. If it isn't yours, throw it (Q) and it flies to its owner.
coleccionista.enc.hud.tu_llave: Your key is in Piece %s's barrel: ask for it.
coleccionista.enc.hud.su_llave: Their key is in your barrel: take it out and throw it with Q.
coleccionista.panel.enc_preparar_ayuda: Fade to black and everyone wakes up chained in the Shackle Hall, in pairs (random pairs if there are none).
coleccionista.panel.enc_empezar_ayuda: The Collector explains the trial on the screens; when he finishes, the gate opens.
coleccionista.panel.enc_ya_ayuda: Opens the gate without the speech.
coleccionista.panel.enc_soltar_ayuda: Removes every wall shackle (in case someone gets stuck). The chain between partners stays.
coleccionista.panel.enc_cerrar_ayuda: Closes the exit now: whoever didn't reach the Shelter is eliminated.
coleccionista.panel.enc_terminar_ayuda: Ends the trial without eliminating anyone: removes the chains, opens the gates and deletes the keys.
coleccionista.panel.enc_cuenta: Safe: %s of %s spots · pairs: %s · chained to the wall: %s
coleccionista.panel.enc_nota: Each pair wakes up chained to the wall; each one's key is in the other's barrel. Then they cross the Sewers tied together (two-plate gates, three pipes where only one works, a bridge) with the gas behind them. When the Shelter is full, the gate closes.
coleccionista.panel.pruebas_proximas: All 7 trials are here. Suggested order: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6 and the final.
coleccionista.panel.enc_estado.lista: Ready: everyone chained, waiting for your signal
coleccionista.panel.enc_estado.cierre: The gate closed: eliminating those outside…
coleccionista.enc.chat.perdon: Nobody made it… How disappointing. The pair that got the furthest stays in my game. For now.
coleccionista.com.sin_mapa: The Table Hall isn't built yet: use /evento construir.
coleccionista.com.ya_empezo: Share or Steal is already running: end it before preparing it again.
coleccionista.com.fundido: It smells of old wood and candle wax…
coleccionista.com.chat.perdonado: %s, you don't play this time. Consider it… a gift.
coleccionista.com.chat.hablen: You have %s seconds to talk with your partner. Then each of you will choose in secret.
coleccionista.com.chat.perdon: Stealing to the very end? How greedy… I won't run out of pieces today.
coleccionista.com.chat.fin: Every table has been revealed. %s pieces stayed in my collection.
coleccionista.com.cmd.preparada: Share or Steal is ready: everyone to the Hall's tables.
coleccionista.com.cmd.no_lista: Prepare Share or Steal first (/evento compartir preparar).
coleccionista.com.cmd.no_toca: That can't be done right now in Share or Steal.
coleccionista.com.reglas: Both share: both go on. One steals: only they go on. Both steal: both stay in the collection. If you don't choose, you share.
coleccionista.com.elegiste_robar: You chose STEAL. Nobody else knows… yet.
coleccionista.com.elegiste_compartir: You chose SHARE. Nobody else knows… yet.
coleccionista.com.hud.perdonado: You don't play this time: the Collector spared you
coleccionista.com.hud.hablen: Talk with %s: then you'll choose in secret
coleccionista.com.res.roban: Both stole: both stay in the collection.
coleccionista.panel.com_preparar_ayuda: Fade to black and everyone to a Hall table, in new random pairs (if the count is odd, one is spared).
coleccionista.panel.com_empezar_ayuda: The Collector explains the trial, then the minute to talk begins.
coleccionista.panel.com_ya_ayuda: Starts the minute to talk without the speech.
coleccionista.panel.com_elegir_ayuda: Ends the talk: everyone gets the screen to choose in secret.
coleccionista.panel.com_revelar_ayuda: Ends the choosing time (whoever didn't choose, shares) and the tables are revealed one by one.
coleccionista.panel.com_terminar_ayuda: Ends the trial (those already eliminated stay eliminated).
coleccionista.panel.com_estado.lista: Ready: everyone at their table, waiting for your signal
coleccionista.pue.sin_mapa: The Door Room isn't built yet: use /evento construir.
coleccionista.pue.ya_empezo: The Doors is already running: end it before preparing it again.
coleccionista.pue.fundido: A cold draft comes from somewhere below…
coleccionista.pue.lema: Behind one of them there is no floor
coleccionista.pue.pista.1: I wouldn't go through the %s door.
coleccionista.pue.pista.3: Behind the %s door there's no floor… or is there?
coleccionista.pue.pista.4: If I were you, I'd stay away from the %s door.
coleccionista.pue.chat.ronda: Round %s of %s. Choose a door and go in before the gates close. And remember: sometimes I lie.
coleccionista.pue.elegi_por_ti: You didn't choose… so I chose for you.
coleccionista.pue.chat.perdon: Everyone at the same door? How boring… This time the floor holds.
coleccionista.pue.chat.trampa: The trap was behind the %s door. There were %s inside.
coleccionista.pue.chat.fin: The doors are done. %s pieces fell into my collection.
coleccionista.pue.cmd.preparada: The Doors is ready (%s rounds): everyone to the lobby.
coleccionista.pue.cmd.no_toca: That can't be done right now in The Doors.
coleccionista.pue.hud.elige: Round %s of %s · get into a booth before the gates close
coleccionista.panel.pue_preparar_ayuda: Fade to black and everyone to the Door Room lobby.
coleccionista.panel.pue_ronda_ayuda: New colors, the Collector's hint and the gates open to choose.
coleccionista.panel.pue_cerrar_ayuda: Ends the choosing time: whoever didn't choose goes into a random booth; then the drumroll and the trap.
coleccionista.panel.pue_terminar_ayuda: Ends the trial (closes the floors and opens the gates).
coleccionista.panel.pue_estado.lista: Ready: everyone in the lobby (round %s of %s)
coleccionista.panel.pue_estado.entre: Between rounds (round %s of %s): press Next round
coleccionista.panel.com_nota: New random pairs, face to face at a table. They talk for a minute, then each chooses in secret: SHARE or STEAL. The tables are revealed one by one on the giant screen and on everyone's screen.
coleccionista.panel.pue_nota: Each round the doors change color and the Collector gives a hint (sometimes he lies). Everyone gets into a booth; in one of them the floor opens. If everyone picks the trapped one, it doesn't open that time. Settings: /evento puertas rondas N and tiempo N.
coleccionista.cop.sin_mapa: The Final Chamber isn't built yet: use /evento construir.
coleccionista.cop.ya_empezo: The final is already running: end it before preparing it again.
coleccionista.cop.muchos: At most %2$s pieces may remain for the final (%1$s remain).
coleccionista.cop.fundido: At last… the final pieces of my collection.
coleccionista.cop.lema: Only one piece leaves this place
coleccionista.cop.chat.turno: Your turn, %s. Choose a cup and drink it.
coleccionista.cop.chat.elijo: Can't decide? I'll choose for you.
coleccionista.cop.chat.sirve: I'll pour again. Once again, one of them is poisoned.
coleccionista.cop.cmd.preparada: The final is ready: the last pieces to the Final Chamber.
coleccionista.cop.cmd.no_toca: That can't be done right now in the final.
coleccionista.cop.cmd.bebe: Whoever has the turn drinks (a random cup).
coleccionista.cop.hud.lista: The final · wait for the signal
coleccionista.panel.cop_preparar_ayuda: Fade to black and the last pieces (2 to 4) to the Final Chamber table, with the cups poured.
coleccionista.panel.cop_empezar_ayuda: The Collector explains the final and the first turn begins.
coleccionista.panel.cop_ya_ayuda: Starts the first turn without the speech.
coleccionista.panel.cop_beber_ayuda: Whoever has the turn drinks a random cup (if they take too long).
coleccionista.panel.cop_terminar_ayuda: Ends the final and removes the cups.
coleccionista.panel.cop_estado.lista: Ready: everyone at the table, waiting for your signal
coleccionista.panel.cop_nota: The last 2 to 4 pieces around the table. There are two more cups than pieces and one is poisoned. Taking turns, each drinks one (right-click); if someone falls and several remain, the cups are poured again. The last piece wins.
coleccionista.sac.sin_mapa: The Chapel isn't built yet: use /evento construir.
coleccionista.sac.ya_empezo: The Sacrifice is already running: end it before preparing it again.
coleccionista.sac.fundido: It smells of incense. Someone prayed here… long ago.
coleccionista.sac.lema: The door only opens if someone stays
coleccionista.sac.chat.ofrecer: Every room has an altar. Whoever stands on it for 5 seconds stays, and the rest walk out free. You have %s seconds to decide.
coleccionista.sac.chat.votar: Nobody dared… Then vote in secret: whoever gets the most votes stays.
coleccionista.sac.chat.ofrecido: Room %s: %s volunteered. How brave… The rest of you, get out.
coleccionista.sac.chat.votado: Room %s: the votes chose %s. The rest of you, get out.
coleccionista.sac.chat.fin: Every room paid its price. %s new pieces in my display cases.

coleccionista.cie.chat.guia: Maze %s: %s guided badly… and stays with me.

coleccionista.voz.org_no: Organizers no longer hear the ghost channel.

coleccionista.enc.regla.1: You're chained to the wall and to your partner.
coleccionista.enc.regla.2: Your key is in your partner's barrel: ask for it. Keys are thrown with Q.
coleccionista.enc.regla.3: Cross the sewers together before the gas reaches you.
coleccionista.enc.regla.4: There's no room for everyone in the Shelter: whoever stays outside falls.
coleccionista.tra.regla.1: Each of you has a note with part of the vault code.
coleccionista.tra.regla.2: One of you is the traitor: their numbers are fake.
coleccionista.tra.regla.3: You have 3 tries on the keypad to open the vault.
coleccionista.tra.regla.4: If you open it, the traitor falls. If not, the traitor chooses who I take.
coleccionista.com.regla.1: You get a partner, face to face. First you talk.
coleccionista.com.regla.2: Then each of you chooses in secret: SHARE or STEAL.
coleccionista.com.regla.3: If both share, both go on. If one steals, the one who shared falls.
coleccionista.com.regla.4: If both steal, both fall. If you don't choose, you share.
coleccionista.cie.regla.1: One of your team is the guide: they walk above and see the whole maze.
coleccionista.cie.regla.2: The others walk blindfolded: all black, just a pulse of light now and then. Listen to your guide.
coleccionista.cie.regla.3: Stepping on a trap sends you back to the entrance. The traps move around.
coleccionista.cie.regla.4: Some tiles on the path light up: cross them while they are dark.
coleccionista.sac.regla.1: Your team is locked in: the gate only opens if someone stays.
coleccionista.sac.regla.2: To offer yourself, stand on the altar for 5 seconds.
coleccionista.sac.regla.3: If nobody offers, you vote in secret. The most voted stays.
coleccionista.sac.regla.4: Whoever stays falls. The rest walk free.
coleccionista.pue.regla.1: Each round, choose one of the three doors and enter its booth.
coleccionista.pue.regla.2: Behind one of them, the floor opens.
coleccionista.pue.regla.3: Before each round I give you a hint. I almost always tell the truth.
coleccionista.pue.regla.4: If you don't get in on time, I choose for you.
coleccionista.cop.regla.1: One of the cups on the table is poisoned.
coleccionista.cop.regla.2: Taking turns, each one drinks a cup (right click).
coleccionista.cop.regla.3: If nobody falls, the cups are poured again.

coleccionista.rec.sin_equipo: %s found no team… and stays with me.

coleccionista.linea.c1.titulo: Chapter 1 · The awakening and The senses
coleccionista.linea.c1.resumen: Cells → big screen → grand hall → lifts → circuits → the display case.
coleccionista.linea.c2.resumen: The Archive: one of them lies.
coleccionista.linea.c4.resumen: The mazes: one blindfolded, one guides.
coleccionista.linea.c5.resumen: The Chapel: someone volunteers or they vote.
coleccionista.linea.c6.resumen: Rounds of doors: one is the trap.
coleccionista.linea.c7.resumen: The final chamber: only one leaves.
coleccionista.linea.p.sala.ayuda: Everyone to their cell, lying down with "Waiting for players". (With automatic sign-up it opens by itself when the first one joins.)
coleccionista.linea.p.despertar.ayuda: Lights come on, everyone sees their awakening and the 5 minutes in the cell begin (no clues, nobody speaking).
coleccionista.linea.p.discurso.ayuda: Without waiting the 5 minutes: blackout, the clues appear and the locks work. The 2 minutes to get out start.
coleccionista.linea.p.abrir_celdas.ayuda: Emergency: opens every cell at once.
coleccionista.linea.p.salida.ayuda: Ends the time to get out now: cells still closed open by themselves and the gate rises. (Normally when the clock hits 0; when the last one gets out, the clock drops to 10 seconds.)
coleccionista.linea.p.porton.ayuda: Raises the gate now (they go into the great hall). When everyone is in, it lowers and the Collector speaks.
coleccionista.linea.p.equipos.ayuda: Without waiting for everyone to enter the great hall: the gate lowers, the Collector welcomes them, asks for teams of 2 or 3 and the 10 lifts open.
coleccionista.linea.p.bajar.ayuda: The lifts go down now. Whoever stayed outside is eliminated; those alone join another team.
coleccionista.linea.p.saltar.ayuda: In the workshop: don't wait for them to leave the lift / cut the speech / hand out the objects and open the door. In the theater: open the curtain now, or close the exit now.
coleccionista.linea.p.terminar.ayuda: Time's up: teams that didn't arrive appear seated in their exit room and the gas comes (they lose).
coleccionista.linea.p.limpiar.ayuda: Removes chairs, wax and statues from the theater, closes the curtain and resets the circuits (eliminates nobody).
coleccionista.linea.p.llevar.ayuda: Takes every living piece to this trial's hall (in the arrival lift).
coleccionista.linea.p.preparar.ayuda: Sets up the trial: teams, doors and places.
coleccionista.linea.p.empezar.ayuda: The Collector speaks and the trial begins.
coleccionista.linea.p.tra_cortar.ayuda: Ends the search and goes to the vote.
coleccionista.linea.p.com_elegir.ayuda: Ends the talk: now they choose share or steal.
coleccionista.linea.p.cop_beber.ayuda: Forces the player whose turn it is to drink.
coleccionista.linea.p.pue_ronda.ayuda: Starts the next round of doors.
coleccionista.linea.p.pue_cerrar.ayuda: Closes the doors and reveals the trap.
coleccionista.linea.p.terminar_prueba.ay: Closes the trial (cleans up what is left).
coleccionista.linea.chat_ayuda: With the chat closed only organizers can write.
coleccionista.linea.auto_ayuda: Auto: whoever joins before the start is signed up, goes to their cell and sees "Waiting for players" (operators are not).
coleccionista.linea.panel_ayuda: The usual panel: pieces, teams, clock, trials and cameras.
coleccionista.linea.sesion_ayuda: Removes the ✔ marks of used steps (only on your screen).
coleccionista.cmd.mapa_actualiza: The mod brings map changes: rebuilding %s zone(s)… (don't go in yet)
coleccionista.diario.quitado: You left the diary page in the cell.
coleccionista.gas.msg2: The Collector doesn't like slow pieces… he prefers them still.
coleccionista.salida.abierta_sola: Your cell opened by itself… this time.
coleccionista.salir.sub: You have %s minutes to get out of your cell
coleccionista.sen.esperen: Wait seated. Other teams are still out there…
coleccionista.sen.final.salgan: The straps open. Stand up (Shift) and go out.
coleccionista.sen.pasarela: The plank walk: if anyone falls into the ditch, everyone goes back to the start.
coleccionista.sen.etapa.pasarela: The plank walk: stay on the plank, don't fall into the ditch
coleccionista.linea.pocos_ayuda: To test with 2 or 3 people: nobody is spared for being among the last and, if there is a single team in the senses trial, it loses too (so you see the whole display case ending). Turn it off for the real event.
